decisions.reason: Address autocomplete is a low-maintenance web service that complements the firm's address and postal-code data, so it likely brings steady recurring revenue.
The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core grid-fee data business into a neighbouring market, though its niche size carries some risk.
Peak load window determination is required by grid-fee regulation, so energy suppliers keep needing it and it fits the firm's existing data offering.
An end-customer tariff database is central to an energy-market data provider and likely sold on subscription to many clients.
Custom web services draw on the firm's existing programming skills and generate project revenue at little extra cost.
Postal code lookup is basic infrastructure for assigning grid areas and tariffs and is cheap to maintain.
